Keep eight distinct complete silhouettes, green separation and safe outer edges. No body density correction or aesthetic changes. No extra figures, head-only closeup row, copied guides, text, labels, arrows, props, shadows, detached effects, green inside figures, manual cell splice or whole-sprite rotation.
